title.zh: 奇绩创坛回应美国制裁：否认投资上海至算
title.en: 奇绩创坛回应美国制裁：否认投资上海至算

current_state.zh: MiraclePlus denied US allegations that it invested in Shanghai Zhisuan and said it is communicating with relevant parties after parts of its entities were added to a US sanctions list.
